# Soma Novel

> Free English and Kiswahili web novels from East Africa.

Soma Novel publishes original web fiction in English and Kiswahili. Book details and chapter lists are available as public HTML pages under /books/.

## Catalogue

- https://somanovel.uk/books/
- https://somanovel.uk/sitemap.xml

## Use

Please attribute Soma Novel and link to the canonical book page when citing a title or synopsis. Do not reproduce full chapter text.
